svg.title: F155 pacing in the engine: the interface design

g.text: F155 pacing in the engine: the interface design
paces its words on the page when the server does not (F156)
a burst comes out at the pace
a tool call waits for the text before it
a reader into a channel, a writer at the pace
static double Next(double shown, int arrived, TimeSpan

text.tspan: The engine's turn stream passes, when a host turns it on, through a paced stream that hands out its text at the pace WordPace says, the rule the web already uses, moved where both can read it.
